title: Day 1: fewer repeated steps
question: Which parts of this simplification should we apply?

options.label: train
options.note: Keep the two-step lunchbox, lessons and rescue. Remove repeated narration, merge three replies and let Mio answer her buzzing phone during the conversation. [Scene counts and exact lines](#doc/reviews/day1-simplify/train.md).

options.label: gate
options.note: Show the useful briefcase mime immediately. Keep both solutions, typed akete and optional cat/squeeze jokes. Shorten repeated explanations. [Scene counts and exact lines](#doc/reviews/day1-simplify/gate.md).

options.label: lift
options.note: Five advances become three. Keep the B2 gossip and the moment they notice Eric’s card. [Exact lift edits, below gate proposal](#doc/reviews/day1-simplify/gate.md).

options.label: office
options.note: One knock opens Mio’s door; the chair conversation leads straight into her request. Shorten repeated ticket and gesture text; keep both lunches, typing and cup payoff. [Scene counts and exact lines](#doc/reviews/day1-simplify/office.md).
